newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Australia govt adopts new Sydney flight plans.
newsitem.headline: Australia govt adopts new Sydney flight plans.

text.p: Australian Transport Minister John Sharp said on Thursday the government had adopted a proposed long-term operating plan for Sydney airport, which would move more take-offs and landings over Botany Bay.
"There will be a significant improvement in noise sharing with more than half of all aircraft movements out over water instead of residential areas," Sharp said in a statement.
Under the plan, 55 percent of aircraft movements would be to the south over the water, 17 percent would be to the north of the airport, 15 percent to the west and 13 percent to the east.
But he stressed that the operational changes would be subject to an environmental impact study.
The Environment Department would receive details of the proposals within the next week, Sharp said.
